---
title: "Human-driven trophic simplification in Azorean lake ecosystems"
output:
  pdf_document: default
---

**About this script.** This R Markdown reproduces the analyses for the manuscript on trophic structure change in Azorean lakes over the past ~2000 years. It loads data (DCA scores, guild abundances, climate reconstructions, pollen), runs variance partitioning (phase-based and moving window), sensitivity analyses (phase boundaries, leave-one-out, null models), and produces main and supplementary figures. Custom helper functions are in `functions/source_custom_functions.R`. Run chunks in order; all packages are loaded in the first code section.

```{r}
# Set-up chunk
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.pos = "H",
  fig.width = 12
)
```

# Load libraries
```{r sources, include=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# All dependencies are loaded once here. Do not add library() in later chunks;
# if a package is needed, add it below and re-run this chunk.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# -------------------------------
# 🧰 General-Purpose & Data Handling
# -------------------------------
library(tidyverse)      # Loads: ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr, readr, purrr, tibble, stringr, forcats
library(zoo)            # Time-series objects and interpolation
library(parallel)       # Base R parallel processing support
library(furrr)          # Parallel purrr (requires future backend)
library(sf)             # Spatial vector data handling

# -------------------------------
# 🖍 Aesthetic & Utility Enhancements
# -------------------------------
library(scales)         # Useful for custom ggplot2 axes
library(png)            # For reading PNG images (only if you're embedding raster images)
library(ggtext)         # Rich text/markdown/emoji in ggplot2 elements
library(Hmisc)          # For `capitalize()` or advanced summary stats
library(scico)          # Color palettes (colorblind-safe, perceptually uniform)
library(conflicted)     # Safer namespace conflict management

# -------------------------------
# 📊 Visualization & Plot Layout
# -------------------------------
# ggplot2 already loaded via tidyverse, but other extensions aren't:
library(ggrepel)        # Smart label positioning
library(ggpmisc)        # Annotations and statistical labels
library(viridis)        # Better color palettes
library(cowplot)        # Clean multi-panel figures
library(patchwork)      # Combine ggplots with intuitive syntax
library(gridExtra)      # Arrange base or ggplots in grids
library(grid)           # Base graphics system (already available, no need to load)
library(ggnewscale)     # Multiple color/fill scales
library(ggridges)       # Ridgeline plots
library(ggh4x)          # Extended faceting and axes
library(ggspatial)      # North arrows, scale bars, etc.
library(ggordiplots)    # Ordination diagrams (RDA, CCA, NMDS)

# -------------------------------
# 📈 Statistical Analysis & Modeling
# -------------------------------
library(vegan)          # Ecological ordination (NMDS, CCA, RDA), diversity metrics
library(codyn)          # Temporal beta-diversity and dynamics
library(broom)          # Tidy model outputs
library(mgcv)           # Generalized Additive Models
library(scam)           # Shape-constrained additive models
library(gratia)         # Diagnostics and visualization for `mgcv::gam()`

# -------------------------------
# 🤖 Machine Learning & Interpretation
# -------------------------------
library(caret)          # Framework for ML model training/testing
library(e1071)          # SVMs, Naive Bayes, etc. (caret dependency)
library(evtree)         # Evolutionary trees
library(rpart)          # Classification/regression trees
library(randomForest)   # Random Forests
library(rpart.plot)     # Visualize rpart trees
library(earth)          # MARS regression
library(DALEX)          # Model explanation tools
library(DALEXtra)       # Extra methods for xgboost, caret, etc.
library(irr)            # Inter-rater agreement (Cohen's Kappa, etc.)
library(ape)            # Phylogenetic tools (tree manipulation, distances)

# -------------------------------
# 📂 Custom Functions
# -------------------------------
source("functions/source_custom_functions.R")  # Custom paleoecological tools

# -------------------------------
# 🚨 Solve Function Conflicts
# -------------------------------
conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("rename", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("summarise", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("summarize", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("explain", "DALEX")
conflict_prefer("annotate", "ggplot2")

# -------------------------------
# Output folders (create if missing)
# -------------------------------
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create("supplementary", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Load data
```{r}

load("data/clean_source_data_files.RData")

# Define functional groups (used throughout trophic structure analyses)
alternative_functional_groups_guilds_globi_merged <- c(
  "high_profile", "low_profile", "motile", "euplanktonic",
  "algivore", "detritivore", "plantivore", "predator"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load lake metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
lake_metadata <- read.csv(file = "data/table_lake_metadata.csv")  # lake coordinates, area, etc.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load guild relative abundances and diversity tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
norm_abund_guilds <- read.table("data/table_abundance_guilds.csv",header = TRUE, sep = ",", dec = ".")
div_guilds <- read.table("data/table_diversity_guilds.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", dec = ".")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load climate and environmental reconstructions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
nao_hernandez <- read.table("data/table_nao_hernandez.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", dec = ".")
nhst_buntgen <- read.table("data/table_nhst_buntgen.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", dec = ".")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load pollen group data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
pollen <- read.table("data/table_pollen_azores.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", dec = ".")

```

```{r fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 12}
# Combine all DCA scores into a single long-format dataframe

df_dca_multi <- bind_rows(
 b_ls_dca_diatoms,
 b_ls_dca_chiro,
 b_ls_dca_fgroup,
 .id = "troph"  # 1 = diatoms, 2 = chiro, 3 = fgroups
) %>%
 mutate(group = as.factor(troph))  # Ensure group is treated as factor for plotting

# --------------------------------------------
# Split data by lake into a list for faceted plotting
# --------------------------------------------
ls_dca_multi <- df_dca_multi %>%
 group_split(lake)

# Assign lake names as list names
names(ls_dca_multi) <- unlist(get_names_list(ls_dca_multi))

# --------------------------------------------
# Create list of plots comparing diatoms vs chironomids by lake
# --------------------------------------------
ls_plot_df_dca_multi_all <- 
 ls_dca_multi %>%
 map(~ .x %>% filter(group %in% 1:2)) %>%  # Filter to diatoms (1) and chironomids (2)
 map2(
   ., names(ls_dca_multi),
   ~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = age_ce, y = DCA1)) +
     geom_smooth(
       aes(colour = group), 
       linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.5, method = "gam", show.legend = TRUE
     ) +
     # Optional: Add raw points if desired
     # geom_point(aes(color = group), size = 3) +
     scale_colour_viridis_d(
       name = "Groups",
       labels = c("Producers", "Consumers")
     ) +
     theme(plot.background = NULL) +
     labs(title = .y) +  # Lake name as plot title
     theme_bw() +
     theme(
       plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
       legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", linewidth = 4, colour = "white"),
       legend.justification = c(0, 1),
       legend.position.inside = c(0, 1),
       axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2),
       panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2),
       panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
     )
 )
```

# Analysis - Community Trophic Structure Analysis
## Get clusters 
```{r fig.asp = 0.5, fig.width = 12}

# --------------------------------------------
# Combine list of functional group data frames into one table
# --------------------------------------------
tab_sums <- 
  ls_df_fg %>% 
  map(~.x %>% as.data.frame()) %>%  # Convert each list element to data frame
  bind_rows()  # Combine into one unified data frame

# --------------------------------------------
# Normalize abundance data by row (i.e., relative abundance)
# --------------------------------------------
norm_abund <- 
  bind_cols(
    select(tab_sums, lake:age_ce),  # Retain identifying metadata
    select(tab_sums, high_profile:euplanktonic) / rowSums(select(tab_sums, high_profile:euplanktonic)),  # Normalize functional groups
    select(tab_sums, algivore:last_col()) / rowSums(select(tab_sums, algivore:last_col()))  # Normalize trait groups
  ) %>% 
  replace(is.na(.), 0)  # Replace any resulting NAs with 0s

# --------------------------------------------
# Detect available CPU cores for parallel processing
# --------------------------------------------
numCores <- parallel::detectCores()

# --------------------------------------------
# 4. Run clustering optimization to identify best AMD cluster number
# --------------------------------------------
ls_opt_clusts <- 
  norm_abund %>%
  select(-c(lake:age_ce)) %>%  # Remove metadata columns
  PlotoptAMDclusters(., .iterations = 1000, .min_clusts = 3, .num_groups = 9)  # Evaluate from 3 to 9 clusters

# --------------------------------------------
# Identify optimal number of clusters via asymptote detection
# --------------------------------------------
x <- ls_opt_clusts$results$.clusters
y <- ls_opt_clusts$results$.maxpmean
dy <- diff(y)  # Rate of change in model performance
threshold <- 0.01  # Define a threshold for plateau detection
asymptote_point <- which(abs(dy) < threshold)[1]  # First point where improvement stabilizes

# Visual check for asymptote
plot(x, y, type = "l", main = "Identifying Asymptote")
points(x[asymptote_point], y[asymptote_point], col = "red", pch = 19, cex = 1.5)
abline(v = x[asymptote_point], col = "blue", lty = 2)
text(x[asymptote_point], y[asymptote_point], labels = paste0("x = ", x[asymptote_point]), pos = 4)

# Extract cluster number at asymptote
ls_opt_clusts <- as.vector(ls_opt_clusts$results[asymptote_point, 1])$.clusters

# --------------------------------------------
# Assign cluster identity to each row (sample)
# --------------------------------------------
opt_AMD_clusts_fgroups_paleo <- 
  norm_abund %>%
  select(-c(lake:age_ce)) %>%  # Remove metadata
  select_if(~ sum(.) > 0) %>%  # Drop zero-only columns
  getAMDclusters(.data = ., .opt_num_clusts = ls_opt_clusts, .iterations = 5000) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(amd_clusts = .clst)  # Rename cluster column

# Ensure cluster is a proper factor
opt_AMD_clusts_fgroups_paleo <- opt_AMD_clusts_fgroups_paleo %>%
  mutate(amd_clusts = factor(as.vector(unlist(.[, "amd_clusts"]))))

# --------------------------------------------
# Prepare ordination scores and metadata
# --------------------------------------------
glob_df_pcoa_scores_fgroups <- bind_rows(ls_df_pcoa_scores_fgroups)

# Subset ordination scores to match samples in norm_abund
sub_glob_df_pcoa_scores_fgroups <- 
  glob_df_pcoa_scores_fgroups %>% 
  filter(core_depth_id %in% norm_abund$core_depth_id)

# --------------------------------------------
# Merge metadata, ordination, and cluster assignment into one table
# --------------------------------------------
global_matrix_merged_paleo <- 
  bind_cols(
    select(norm_abund, lake:age_ce),
    select(sub_glob_df_pcoa_scores_fgroups, DCA1:DCA2),
    amd_clusts = factor(opt_AMD_clusts_fgroups_paleo[, 1])  # Add cluster assignment
  ) %>% 
  left_join(., 
            select(ungroup(df_fgroups_glob_div), core_depth_id:total_nspp_by_lake_core) %>% 
              distinct(),
            by = "core_depth_id")

# --------------------------------------------
# Create color mapping key based on cluster means
# --------------------------------------------
key <- 
  bind_cols(
    global_matrix_merged_paleo,
    select(norm_abund, c(high_profile:last_col()))
  ) %>% 
  group_by(amd_clusts) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_euplanktonic = mean(euplanktonic, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_total_nspp_by_lake_core = mean(total_nspp_by_lake_core, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
  arrange(mean_total_nspp_by_lake_core) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number())  # Assign ranking based on richness

# --------------------------------------------
# Apply ranking to cluster IDs (relabel clusters by complexity)
# --------------------------------------------
cluster_mapping <- key %>% 
  select(amd_clusts, rank) %>% 
  deframe()  # Convert to named vector

# Replace cluster IDs with rank values
global_matrix_merged_paleo <- global_matrix_merged_paleo %>%
  mutate(amd_clusts = cluster_mapping[as.character(amd_clusts)]) %>%
  mutate(amd_clusts = as.factor(amd_clusts))

# --------------------------------------------
# [Decision made here] Merge two cluster levels
# --------------------------------------------
global_matrix_merged_paleo$amd_clusts[global_matrix_merged_paleo$amd_clusts == 6] <- 5

# --------------------------------------------
# Split final data frame by lake into a named list
# --------------------------------------------
ls_all_hclusts_complete_paleo <- 
  global_matrix_merged_paleo %>%
  group_split(lake)

# Assign names to list elements using helper function
names(ls_all_hclusts_complete_paleo) <- unlist(get_names_list(ls_all_hclusts_complete_paleo))
```

## Diversity by community trophic clusters
```{r fig.asp=1, fig.width=12}

# ----------------------------------------------
# Merge all lake-specific dataframes into one long-format table
# ----------------------------------------------
merged_data <- ls_all_hclusts_complete_paleo %>%
  map(~.x %>% as.data.frame()) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  filter(age_ce > 0) %>%  # Remove non-positive ages (pre-zero)
  select(lake, core_depth_id, amd_clusts, total_nspp_by_lake_core) %>%
  unique()

# ----------------------------------------------
# Perform ANOVA and Tukey post-hoc test
# ----------------------------------------------
anova_res <- aov(total_nspp_by_lake_core ~ amd_clusts, data = merged_data)
tukey_res <- TukeyHSD(anova_res)

# Generate compact letter display to indicate group differences
cld <- multcompView::multcompLetters4(anova_res, tukey_res)

# Extract significant letters and prepare for plotting
signif_letters <- data.frame(
  amd_clusts = names(cld$amd_clusts$Letters),
  letters = cld$amd_clusts$Letters
)

# Add y-position for each letter above boxplots
signif_letters <- signif_letters %>%
  left_join(
    merged_data %>%
      group_by(amd_clusts) %>%
      summarise(max_y = max(total_nspp_by_lake_core, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = "amd_clusts"
  ) %>%
  mutate(y_position = max_y * 1.1)

# ----------------------------------------------
# Create boxplot comparing diversity across clusters (all lakes combined)
# ----------------------------------------------
box_plot_clusts <- ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = amd_clusts, y = total_nspp_by_lake_core)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = amd_clusts)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = amd_clusts, y = y_position, label = letters),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    data = signif_letters, size = 6
  ) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(method = "anova", label.y = 9, cex = 4) +  # ANOVA p-value label
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Community Trophic \nstructures", option = "viridis", direction = -1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Community Trophic Structures", y = "Number of species") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", linewidth = 4, colour = "white"),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Assuming your x-axis variable is called 'x_var' in fig_2_time_clusts data:
box_plot_clusts$data$amd_clusts <- factor(box_plot_clusts$data$amd_clusts, 
                                       levels = c(6,5,4,3,2,1))
box_plot_clusts_mod <- 
  box_plot_clusts + 
  scale_fill_viridis_d(direction = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Rebuild the plot to reflect the new x-axis order
box_plot_clusts_mod <- box_plot_clusts_mod +
  scale_x_discrete()  # Ensures x-axis reflects the new order

# Create the inset plot

  #theme(plot.background = element_rect(             # Add a box around the plot
```

## Lake-scale proportions trophic structures 
```{r fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 12}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define vertical reference lines for key historical periods
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
highlighted_dates <- c(750, 1050, 1450, 1750)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine clustering outputs from all lakes into a single data frame
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
data_combined <- ls_all_hclusts_complete_paleo %>%
  map_dfr(as.data.frame)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute time coverage per lake and order lakes by coverage length
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
lake_ranges <- data_combined %>%
  group_by(lake) %>%
  summarise(
    min_age = min(age_ce, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_age = max(age_ce, na.rm = TRUE),
    data_range = max_age - min_age,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(data_range))

lake_levels <- lake_ranges$lake  # Preserve lake order for plotting

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set lake as ordered factor and cluster as categorical
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
data_combined <- data_combined %>%
  mutate(
    lake = factor(lake, levels = lake_levels),
    amd_clusts = as.factor(amd_clusts)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define shaded rectangles to mask periods without data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
rect_data <- lake_ranges %>%
  select(lake, min_age, max_age) %>%
  mutate(
    lake = factor(lake, levels = lake_levels),
    xmin1 = 0,
    xmax1 = min_age,
    xmin2 = max_age,
    xmax2 = 2010
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(xmin1, xmin2), names_to = "rect_part", values_to = "xmin") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(xmax1, xmax2), names_to = "rect_part2", values_to = "xmax") %>%
  filter(substr(rect_part, 5, 5) == substr(rect_part2, 5, 5)) %>%
  select(lake, xmin, xmax) %>%
  mutate(ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Keep only lakes with ≥2 trophic clusters
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
lake_valid_clusters <- data_combined %>%
  distinct(lake, amd_clusts) %>%
  count(lake) %>%
  filter(n >= 2) %>%
  pull(lake)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Final filtering: remove sparse groups and ensure valid lake set
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
data_combined_clean <- data_combined %>%
  filter(
    lake %in% lake_valid_clusters,
    !is.na(age_ce), !is.na(amd_clusts),
    is.finite(age_ce)
  ) %>%
  group_by(lake, amd_clusts) %>%
  filter(n() >= 3, sd(age_ce, na.rm = TRUE) > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

rect_data_clean <- rect_data %>%
  filter(lake %in% lake_valid_clusters)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build final plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
plot_density_fclusts_time_lines_1B <- 
  ggplot(data_combined_clean, aes(x = age_ce, fill = amd_clusts)) +
  facet_wrap(~ lake, ncol = 1, scales = "fixed", strip.position = "right") +
  geom_density(adjust = 1.5, position = "fill", colour = "white") +
  geom_rect(
    data = rect_data_clean,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "white", colour = "white"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = highlighted_dates, colour = "white", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    name = "Community Trophic \nstructures", option = "viridis", direction = -1
  ) +
  lims(x = c(0, 2010)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5", "1")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", linewidth = 4, colour = "white"),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin = unit(c(2, 1, 1, 1), "cm")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Age (CE)",
    y = "Proportion of Community Trophic Structures",
    title = "Proportions of Community Trophic Structures Over Time by Lake"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Render final plot (warning suppressed due to known density dropouts)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
suppressWarnings(print(plot_density_fclusts_time_lines_1B))
```

## Ordination with trophic structures
```{r fig.asp = 0.5, fig.width = 12}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute ordination using PCoA on Bray-Curtis dissimilarity
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ordinations_paleo <- norm_abund %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(-c(lake:age_ce)) %>%                        # Drop metadata columns
  vegdist(method = "bray", na.rm = TRUE) %>%         # Bray-Curtis distance
  cmdscale() %>%                                     # PCoA
  scores() %>%
  as.data.frame()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit environmental vectors (alternative functional groups) to ordination
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
fit_env_paleo <- ordinations_paleo %>%
  envfit(
    env = select(norm_abund, alternative_functional_groups_guilds_globi_merged),
    scaling = "sites"
  ) %>%
  scores("vectors") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    Dim1 = Dim1 * 0.75,
    Dim2 = Dim2 * 0.75,
    groups = rownames(.)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute convex hulls (polygons) for each trophic structure (cluster)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
hull_paleo <- bind_cols(
    ordinations_paleo,
    select(norm_abund, alternative_functional_groups_guilds_globi_merged),
    select(global_matrix_merged_paleo, DCA1:amd_clusts)
  ) %>%
  group_by(amd_clusts) %>%
  dplyr::slice(chull(Dim1, Dim2))  # Convex hull per cluster

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rename cluster levels for better readability (CTS1–CTS5)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
global_matrix_merged_paleo$amd_clusts <- factor(
  global_matrix_merged_paleo$amd_clusts,
  levels = 1:5,
  labels = c("CTS1", "CTS2", "CTS3", "CTS4", "CTS5")
)

hull_paleo$amd_clusts <- factor(
  hull_paleo$amd_clusts,
  levels = 1:5,
  labels = c("CTS1", "CTS2", "CTS3", "CTS4", "CTS5")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assemble full ordination plot with polygons, points, and fitted vectors
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ordinations_fclusts_1 <- ordinations_paleo %>%
  bind_cols(
    select(norm_abund, -alternative_functional_groups_guilds_globi_merged),
    .,
    select(global_matrix_merged_paleo, DCA1:amd_clusts)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Dim1, y = Dim2)) +
  
  # Polygons for each trophic structure
  geom_polygon(
    data = hull_paleo,
    aes(fill = as.factor(amd_clusts)),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis", direction = -1, guide = "none") +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  
  # Points colored by cluster
  geom_point(aes(colour = as.factor(amd_clusts)), size = 3) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(
    option = "viridis", direction = -1,
    name = "Community Trophic Structures"
  ) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +

  # Environmental vectors
  geom_segment(
    data = fit_env_paleo,
    aes(x = 0, xend = Dim1, y = 0, yend = Dim2),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm"))
  ) +

  # Environmental labels
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = fit_env_paleo,
    aes(x = Dim1, y = Dim2, label = groups),
    max.overlaps = 12,
    size = 3,
    direction = "both",
    segment.size = 0.25
  ) +

  # Styling
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", linewidth = 4, colour = "white"),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.position = NULL,
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Render plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ordinations_fclusts_1

```

## Random Forest
```{r}

# ----------------------------
# Data Preparation
# ----------------------------

# Combine global matrix with normalized abundance data (excluding lake to age_ce columns)
datRF_paleo <- bind_cols(
  global_matrix_merged_paleo,
  select(norm_abund, -c(lake:age_ce))
) %>% 
  select(amd_clusts:last_col()) %>%     # Keep columns from amd_clusts to the last
  select(-total_nspp_by_lake_core)      # Remove total species richness column

# ----------------------------
# Random Forest Classification
# ----------------------------

# Convert cluster variable to factor for classification
datRF_paleo$amd_clusts <- as.factor(datRF_paleo$amd_clusts)

# Display class distribution
table(datRF_paleo$amd_clusts)

# Get the minimum class size (for potential balancing use)
min <- as.numeric(min(table(datRF_paleo$amd_clusts)))

# Fit random forest classifier with 1000 trees and variable importance enabled
RFfit_paleo <- randomForest(amd_clusts ~ ., data = datRF_paleo, ntree = 1000, importance = TRUE)

# ----------------------------
# 1.1 Out-of-Bag (OOB) Prediction Accuracy
# ----------------------------

# Predict using OOB samples (internal validation)
pred_paleo <- predict(RFfit_paleo)

# Append predictions to the original data
datRF_paleo <- cbind(pred_paleo, datRF_paleo)

# Confusion matrix: observed vs predicted clusters
tabrp_paleo <- table(datRF_paleo$amd_clusts, datRF_paleo$pred_paleo)

# Print row-wise classification accuracy (%)
round(100 * (prop.table(tabrp_paleo, 1)), 0)

# Print overall classification accuracy
paste("Classification accuracy:", round((100 * (sum(diag(tabrp_paleo)) / sum(tabrp_paleo))), 0), "%")

# Compute Cohen’s Kappa for classification agreement
kappa <- kappa2(datRF_paleo[, c(1, 2)], "equal")
round(kappa$value, 2)  # Interpret as moderate if between 0.4 and 0.6

# Diagonal: per-class correct classification %
diag(round(100 * (prop.table(tabrp_paleo, 1)), 0))

# ----------------------------
# Variable Importance and Partial Dependence Profiles (PDPs)
# ----------------------------

# Use DALEX to explain model behavior
explainer_paleo <- explain(model = RFfit_paleo, datRF_paleo[, -c(1:2)], datRF_paleo$amd_clusts)

# Compute and display variable importance via DALEX
imp_paleo <- variable_importance(explainer_paleo)
imp_paleo
plot(imp_paleo)

# Compute and plot PDPs (marginal effects of predictors)
pdp10_paleo <- model_profile(explainer_paleo)
plot(pdp10_paleo)

# ----------------------------
# Decision Tree Visualization
# ----------------------------

# Re-confirm amd_clusts is treated as a factor
datRF_paleo <- datRF_paleo %>%
  mutate(amd_clusts = as.factor(amd_clusts))

# Fit a decision tree using rpart (excluding predictions and response itself)
decision_tree_paleo <- rpart(
  datRF_paleo$amd_clusts ~ .,
  data = select(datRF_paleo, -c(pred_paleo, amd_clusts)),
  method = "class",
  cp = 0.035
)

# Display complexity parameter table
printcp(decision_tree_paleo)

# --------------------------------------------
# Save the decision tree as a high-resolution PNG image
# --------------------------------------------
png("outputs/decision_tree_paleo.png", width = 2000, height = 1400, res = 300)
rpart.plot::rpart.plot(
  decision_tree_paleo, 
  type = 5,

)
```

# Analysis - Hierarchical Generalized Additive Models - HGAMs
## GAM - Diatoms
### Regional Smooth
```{r}

lakes_col <- c(viridis::viridis(9, option = "plasma", alpha = 0.8))
lakes_col_10 <- c("black", viridis::viridis(10, option = "plasma", alpha = 0.8))

b_ls_dca_diatoms <-
  b_ls_dca_diatoms %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(age_ce)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!lake %in% c("Fogo", "Furnas" ))

# global model diatoms
modGI_diatoms <- 
  b_ls_dca_diatoms %>%
  mutate(lake = as.factor(lake)) %>%
  gam(
    DCA1 ~
      s(age_ce, bs = "tp", k = 30) +
      s(age_ce, by = lake, k = 8, m = 1, bs = "tp") +
      s(lake, bs = "re", k = 8),
    data = ., method = "REML"
  )

# Output p.Time.GI, p.time.derivative
mod_diatoms <- modGI_diatoms

# Model diagnostics
summary(mod_diatoms)
k.check(mod_diatoms, subsample=5000, n.rep=400)
gam.check(mod_diatoms)
appraise(mod_diatoms)
gratia::draw(mod_diatoms, residuals = T)

# get the model data to plot
# evaluate the smooths
smooth_diatoms <- smooth_estimates(mod_diatoms) %>%
  add_confint()

# add partial residuals to data
df_partial_residuals_diatoms <- 
  b_ls_dca_diatoms %>%
  add_partial_residuals(., model = mod_diatoms)

# add label
sum1 <- summary(mod_diatoms)
lab1 <- paste("AdjRsq = ", round(sum1$r.sq,2),
              "\nDevExpl = ", round(sum1$dev.expl,2))

plot_time_GI_diatoms <- 
  smooth_diatoms %>%
  filter(.smooth == "s(age_ce)") %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_rug(aes(x = age_ce),
    data = df_partial_residuals_diatoms,
    sides = "b", length = grid::unit(0.02, "npc")
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .lower_ci, ymax = .upper_ci, x = age_ce),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  # geom_point(aes(x = age_ce, y = `s(age_ce)`, color = lake),
  #           data = df_partial_residuals_diatoms, alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(x = age_ce, y = .estimate), lwd = 1) +
  labs(y = "DCA1", title = "s(age_ce) GI model") +
  scale_color_manual("Time-Interval") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 5, limits = c(0, 2020)) +
  lims(y = c(-2, 2)) +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
    annotate("text_npc", npcx = 0.05, npcy = .95, label = lab1, cex = 3.5)

#plot_time_GI_diatoms

```

# Multivariate Analysis - Redundancy Analysis and Variance Partitioning
## Data prep - Vegetation change - Regional Vegetation change
```{r}
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Load and clean pollen data
# ----------------------------------------------------------

pollen <- pollen %>% 
  rename(age_bp = age) %>% 
  mutate(age_ce = 1950 - age_bp) %>% 
  mutate(ID = paste0(sitename, "_", age_ce))

df_1 <- pollen

# Filter out aquatic and unidentified taxa, then group by ecological group
df_wk <- df_1 %>%
  filter(!ecologicalgroup %in% c("UNID", "AQVP", "AQBR")) %>%
  group_by(ID, sitename, age_ce, group) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(percentage = value / sum(value) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate group-wise mean percentages and anomalies
df_wk <- df_wk %>%
  group_by(sitename, group) %>%
  mutate(mean_percentage = mean(percentage)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(percent_anomaly = percentage - mean_percentage) %>%
  select(-mean_percentage) %>%
  droplevels()

sites_col <- scico(n_distinct(df_wk$sitename), begin = 0, end = 0.95, palette = 'roma')
gr_col <- scico(n_distinct(df_wk$group), begin = 0, end = 0.95, palette = 'nuuk')

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# DCA Analysis
# ----------------------------------------------------------

exclude_sites <- c("Lomba", "Rasa")
df_wk_dca <- df_1 %>%
  filter(!ecologicalgroup %in% c("UNID"), age_ce > 0, !sitename %in% exclude_sites) %>%
  droplevels()

results_list <- lapply(sort(unique(df_wk_dca$sitename)), function(site) {
  df.sp <- df_wk_dca %>%
    filter(sitename == site) %>%
    group_by(ID, taxa) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = taxa, values_from = value, values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames("ID") %>%
    select(where(~ any(. != 0)))
  
  df.spe <- decostand(df.sp, method = "hellinger")
  df.DCA <- decorana(df.spe) %>%
    scores(choices = 1) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("ID")
  
  return(df.DCA)
})

DCA.res <- Reduce(full_join, results_list) %>%
  separate(ID, into = c("sitename", "age_ce"), sep = "_", convert = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(sitename, age_ce) %>%
  mutate(DCA1 = case_when(
    sitename == "Azul" ~ -DCA1,
    sitename == "Gingal" ~ -DCA1,
    TRUE ~ DCA1
  ))

DF_to <- DCA.res %>% mutate(sitename = as.factor(sitename))

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# HGAM on DCA
# ----------------------------------------------------------

mod_to <- gam(DCA1 ~ s(age_ce, bs = "tp", k = 25) +
                s(age_ce, by = sitename, bs = "tp", k = 15, m = 1) +
                s(sitename, bs = "re"),
              data = DF_to, method = "REML")

summary(mod_to)
k.check(mod_to, n.rep = 500)
appraise(mod_to)

# Plot smoothed global trend and derivative
sm_to <- smooth_estimates(mod_to) %>% add_confint()
df <- DF_to %>% add_partial_residuals(mod_to)
lakes_col <- scico(length(levels(DF_to$sitename)), begin = 0, end = 0.95, palette = 'roma')

p.DCA.gl <- sm_to %>%
  filter(.smooth == "s(age_ce)") %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_rug(aes(x = age_ce), data = df, sides = "b", length = unit(0.02, "npc")) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = age_ce, ymin = .lower_ci, ymax = .upper_ci), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = age_ce, y = `s(age_ce)`, color = sitename), data = df, alpha = 0.8, size = 1.5) +
  geom_line(aes(x = age_ce, y = .estimate), linewidth = 1) +
  labs(y = "DCA axis-1", x = "Age (CE)") +
  scale_color_manual("Lake", values = lakes_col) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")

mod_to_dev <- derivatives(mod_to, select = "s(age_ce)", eps = 1, level = 0.9, interval = "simultaneous", seed = 22)
color_mapping <- scico(2, begin = 0, end = 0.9, palette = 'vik')

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# HGAM on representative groups
# ----------------------------------------------------------

pollen_clean <- pollen %>%
  filter(elementtype == "pollen", !is.na(value)) %>%
  filter(!sitename %in% c("Lomba", "Rasa"))

sample_totals <- pollen_clean %>%
  group_by(sitename, age_ce) %>%
  summarise(sample_total = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

lake_avg <- sample_totals %>%
  group_by(sitename) %>%
  summarise(avg_lake_total = mean(sample_total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

pollen_normalized <- pollen_clean %>%
  left_join(sample_totals, by = c("sitename", "age_ce")) %>%
  left_join(lake_avg, by = "sitename") %>%
  mutate(
    scaling_factor = avg_lake_total / sample_total,
    value_scaled = value * scaling_factor
  )

# --- Calculate percent composition by group ---

pollen_percent_group <- pollen_normalized %>%
  group_by(sitename, age_ce, group) %>%
  summarise(value_scaled = sum(value_scaled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sitename, age_ce) %>%
  mutate(
    total_scaled = sum(value_scaled),
    percent = (value_scaled / total_scaled) * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(percent)) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group), sitename = factor(sitename)) %>%
  ungroup()

pollen_percent_group <- pollen_percent_group %>%
  mutate(sitename = factor(sitename))  # ensure factor type

# --- GAM fitting function ---
#   defined in `functions/source_custom_functions.R` (fit_gam_group)

# --- Fit GAM for each pollen group ---

gam_models <- pollen_percent_group %>%
  group_split(group) %>%
  set_names(map_chr(., ~ as.character(unique(.x$group)))) %>%
  map(fit_gam_group)

# --- Plotting function per group ---
#   defined in `functions/source_custom_functions.R` (plot_gam_group)

# --- Generate plots ---

plots_all <- map2(names(gam_models), gam_models, plot_gam_group)

final_plot <- wrap_plots(plots_all, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "% of Pollen Groups Over Time (GAM fit)",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
  )

# --- Display plot ---

final_plot

# --- Compare tree vs herb pollen groups ---

tree_data <- pollen_percent_group %>% filter(group == "Tree")
herb_data <- pollen_percent_group %>% filter(group == "Herb")

mod_tree <- fit_gam_group(tree_data)
mod_herb <- fit_gam_group(herb_data)

aug_tree <- augment(mod_tree, type.predict = "response") %>%
  mutate(group = "Tree")

aug_herb <- augment(mod_herb, type.predict = "response") %>%
  mutate(group = "Herb")

combined_df_pollen <- bind_rows(aug_tree, aug_herb)
```

### Pollen analysis
```{r fig.width = 12, fig.asp = 0.5}
# --- taxa lists (edit freely) ---
taxa_cereals   <- c("Cerealia", "Triticum", "Secale", "Zea mays")
taxa_plantago  <- c("Plantago", "Plantago lanceolata", "Plantago major", "Plantago coronopus")

# Conservative "ruderal" list (expand if you want)
taxa_ruderal   <- c("Amaranthaceae", "Artemisia", "Carduus",
                    "Xanthium", "Xanthium strumarium", "Ambrosia",
                    "Achillea", "Centaurea cyanus", "Urtica", "Urtica urens")

# Native/endemic Azores indicators from your taxa list (expand as desired)
taxa_native <- c(
  "Juniperus brevifolia", "Picconia azorica", "Frangula azorica",
  "Prunus lusitanica subsp. azorica", "Prunus lusitanica",
  "Myrica faya", "Erica azorica", "Daboecia azorica",
  "Viburnum treleasei", "Ilex perado subsp. azorica",
  "Hypericum foliosum", "Hedera azorica", "Chaerophyllum azoricum",
  "Sanicula azorica", "Daucus carota subsp. azoricus",
  "Lysimachia azorica", "Vicia dennesiana", "Arceuthobium azoricum"
)

bin_size <- 30

# highlighted dates (your vector)
# highlighted_dates <- c(750, 1050, 1450, 1750)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Denominator: terrestrial pollen total (scaled), per sample
# ------------------------------------------------------------
sample_totals_scaled <- pollen_normalized %>%
  filter(
    elementtype == "pollen",
    !is.na(value_scaled),
    age_ce > 0,
    !ecologicalgroup %in% c("UNID", "AQVP", "AQBR")
  ) %>%
  group_by(sitename, age_ce) %>%
  summarise(total_scaled = sum(value_scaled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Numerators: sum of scaled pollen for each category, per sample
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pollen_4cat <- pollen_normalized %>%
  filter(
    elementtype == "pollen",
    !is.na(value_scaled),
    age_ce > 0,
    !ecologicalgroup %in% c("UNID", "AQVP", "AQBR")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      taxa %in% taxa_cereals  ~ "Cereals (Cerealia)",
      taxa %in% taxa_plantago ~ "Plantago",
      taxa %in% taxa_ruderal  ~ "Ruderal weeds",
      taxa %in% taxa_native   ~ "Native pollen",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  group_by(sitename, age_ce, category) %>%
  summarise(value_scaled_cat = sum(value_scaled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(sample_totals_scaled, by = c("sitename", "age_ce")) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * value_scaled_cat / total_scaled,
    age_bin = floor(age_ce / bin_size) * bin_size,
    category = factor(category, levels = c("Native pollen", "Cereals (Cerealia)", "Plantago", "Ruderal weeds"))
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(percent))

# Optional: thin bins for plotting (every 60 yrs)
pollen_4cat_plot <- pollen_4cat %>%
  mutate(age_bin60 = floor(age_ce / 60) * 60)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Colors: native = green, others = yellow→orange→red
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cat_fill <- c(
  "Native pollen"       = "#2E8B57",  # green
  "Cereals (Cerealia)"  = "#F4D35E",  # yellow
  "Plantago"            = "#F08A24",  # orange
  "Ruderal weeds"       = "#D1495B"   # red
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Violin plot through time + highlighted dates (vertical lines)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
p_violin_time <- ggplot(
  pollen_4cat_plot,
  aes(x = age_bin60, y = percent)
) +

  # --- Historical phase markers ---
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = highlighted_dates,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    linetype = "dashed",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # --- BACKGROUND POINTS (show singletons & rare events) ---
  geom_point(
    aes(color = category),
    position = position_jitter(width = 10, height = 0),
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 0.9
  ) +

  # --- VIOLINS (only where density exists) ---
  geom_violin(
    aes(
      fill  = category,
      group = interaction(category, age_bin60)
    ),
    scale = "width",
    adjust = 1,
    trim = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ category, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = cat_fill) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cat_fill) +

  labs(
    x = "Age (CE) (60-year bins for plotting)",
    y = "% of terrestrial pollen (scaled within lake)",
    title = "Anthropogenic and native pollen indicators through time",
    subtitle = "Points show all observations; violins indicate distributions where sufficient data exist"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_violin_time

# Optional: sqrt scale version (helps when magnitudes differ a lot)
p_violin_time_sqrt <- p_violin_time +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "sqrt") +
  labs(
    y = "% of terrestrial pollen (scaled within lake) [sqrt scale]",
    subtitle = "Violin distributions per time bin (across lakes/samples); dashed lines = highlighted dates; sqrt y-scale"
  )

p_violin_time_sqrt
```
### Pollen analysis
```{r fig.width = 14, fig.asp = 0.5}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# ASSUMES you already have:
#  - pollen_4cat_plot (includes age_bin60, percent, category)
#  - sm_to (global vegetation smooth with age_ce + .estimate + CI columns)
#  - highlighted_dates (e.g., c(750,1050,1450,1750))
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) Order groups bottom -> top (as requested)
cat_levels <- c("Native pollen", "Ruderal weeds", "Plantago", "Cereals (Cerealia)")

pollen_band <- pollen_4cat_plot %>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = cat_levels),
    band_id  = as.integer(category) - 1L   # 0..3
  ) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  mutate(
    # Scale percent within each category so each band has comparable height
    percent_scaled = scales::rescale(percent, to = c(0.05, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE),
    y_band = band_id + percent_scaled
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2) Single global GAM curve (scaled once to the full vertical span of bands)
veg_bg <- sm_to %>%
  dplyr::filter(.smooth == "s(age_ce)") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    age_ce  = age_ce,
    veg_est = .estimate,
    veg_lo  = .lower_ci,
    veg_hi  = .upper_ci
  ) %>%
  arrange(age_ce)

# Store original GAM scale for the RIGHT axis
veg_min <- min(veg_bg$veg_est, na.rm = TRUE)
veg_max <- max(veg_bg$veg_est, na.rm = TRUE)

# Scale GAM y to match band space (single mapping for all bands)
ymin_band <- min(pollen_band$y_band, na.rm = TRUE)
ymax_band <- max(pollen_band$y_band, na.rm = TRUE)

veg_bg <- veg_bg %>%
  mutate(
    veg_y     = scales::rescale(veg_est, to = c(ymin_band, ymax_band)),
    veg_lo_y  = scales::rescale(veg_lo,  to = c(ymin_band, ymax_band)),
    veg_hi_y  = scales::rescale(veg_hi,  to = c(ymin_band, ymax_band)),
    veg_est_scaled = scales::rescale(veg_est, to = c(0, 1))
  )

# 3) Colors: native green, others yellow→orange→red
cat_fill <- c(
  "Native pollen"       = "#2E8B57",
  "Cereals (Cerealia)"  = "#F4D35E",
  "Plantago"            = "#F08A24",
  "Ruderal weeds"       = "#D1495B"
)

# Helper: inverse mapping from band y-space -> original GAM space (for right axis)
#   defined in `functions/source_custom_functions.R` (inv_gam_from_band)

# 4) Build the plot (single GAM behind everything + RIGHT y-axis for GAM)
p_collage_singleGAM <- ggplot() +

  # --- single GAM ribbon (behind everything) ---
  geom_ribbon(
    data = veg_bg,
    aes(x = age_ce, ymin = veg_lo_y, ymax = veg_hi_y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.20
  ) +

  # --- single GAM line: thick + green→yellow gradient, transparent ---
  geom_path(
    data = veg_bg,
    aes(x = age_ce, y = veg_y, colour = veg_est_scaled),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 10,
    alpha = 0.30,
    lineend  = "butt",   # removes rounded caps
    linejoin = "mitre"   # reduces “bubble” joins
  ) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "#2E8B57", high = "#F4D35E", guide = "none") +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +

  # --- phase markers ---
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = highlighted_dates,
    linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # --- points (always shown, includes singletons) ---
  geom_point(
    data = pollen_band,
    aes(x = age_bin60, y = y_band, colour = category),
    position = position_jitter(width = 10, height = 0),
    alpha = 0.25, size = 0.9
  ) +

  # --- violins (only where density exists; singletons still visible as points) ---
  geom_violin(
    data = pollen_band,
    aes(
      x = age_bin60, y = y_band,
      fill  = category,
      group = interaction(category, age_bin60)
    ),
    scale = "width", adjust = 1, trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.75
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = cat_fill) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cat_fill) +

  # --- LEFT axis: bands; RIGHT axis: GAM (secondary axis) ---
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 0:3 + 0.5,
    labels = cat_levels,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.03)),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = inv_gam_from_band,
      name  = "Regional vegetation change (HGAM global smooth)"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Age (CE) (60-year bins for plotting)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Regional vegetation change with anthropogenic/native pollen indicators",
    subtitle = "Background: HGAM global vegetation smooth (± CI). Overlay: pollen distributions per 60-year bin (scaled within each indicator)."
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),

  )
```

## Data prep - Align environmental data
```{r fig.width = 12, fig.asp = 1.2}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vegetation smooth on a yearly grid WITHOUT interpolation
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

interp_years <- 0:2010
ref_site <- levels(DF_to$sitename)[1]

newdata_veg <- tibble(
  age_ce   = interp_years,
  sitename = factor(ref_site, levels = levels(DF_to$sitename))
)

pr_terms <- predict(mod_to, newdata = newdata_veg, type = "terms", se.fit = TRUE)

term_names <- colnames(pr_terms$fit)
idx <- which(term_names == "s(age_ce)")
if (length(idx) == 0) idx <- grep("^s\\(age_ce\\)$", term_names)
if (length(idx) != 1) {
  stop("Could not uniquely identify the global smooth term 's(age_ce)'.\n",
       "Available term names:\n", paste(term_names, collapse = ", "))
}

est <- as.numeric(pr_terms$fit[, idx])
se  <- as.numeric(pr_terms$se.fit[, idx])

alpha <- 0.05
zcrit <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

interpolated_df <- tibble(
  age_ce   = as.integer(interp_years),
  estimate = est,
  lower_ci = est - zcrit * se,
  upper_ci = est + zcrit * se
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare NAO Hernandez (NO interpolation, NO binning)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
colnames(nao_hernandez)[2] <- "age_ce"
colnames(nao_hernandez)[3] <- "nao_lower_ci"
colnames(nao_hernandez)[5] <- "NAO_Median_Value"
colnames(nao_hernandez)[7] <- "nao_upper_ci"

nao_hernandez_interpolated <- nao_hernandez %>%
  mutate(
    #age_ce = round(as.numeric(age_ce)),
    NAO_Median_Value = as.numeric(NAO_Median_Value)
  ) %>%
  filter(age_ce >= 0) %>%
  arrange(age_ce) %>%
  select(age_ce, NAO_Median_Value, nao_lower_ci, nao_upper_ci)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare NHST Büntgen (NO interpolation, NO binning)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
nhst_buntgen <- nhst_buntgen %>%
  mutate(
    age_ce = round(as.numeric(age_ce)),
    Rmean  = as.numeric(Rmean)
  ) %>%
  filter(age_ce >= 0) %>%
  arrange(age_ce)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare normalized guild abundances
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
norm_abund_guilds <- norm_abund_guilds %>%
  mutate(age_ce = round(age_ce))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CTS cluster proportions (requires purrr::map already loaded above)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
combined_data <- ls_all_hclusts_complete_paleo %>%
  map(~as.data.frame(.x)) %>%
  bind_rows()

densities <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(amd_clusts) %>%
  do({
    dens <- density(.$age_ce, adjust = 1.5, from = 0, to = 2010, n = 5001)
    data.frame(age_ce = dens$x, density = dens$y)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

proportions_long <- densities %>%
  group_by(age_ce) %>%
  mutate(total_density = sum(density),
         proportion = density / total_density) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(age_ce = round(age_ce)) %>%
  filter(age_ce >= 0, age_ce <= 2010) %>%
  group_by(age_ce, amd_clusts) %>%
  summarise(average_proportion = mean(proportion, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

prop_comm_matrix <- proportions_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = amd_clusts, values_from = average_proportion)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 30-year bin helper
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
bin_size <- 30

#   bin30() is defined in `functions/source_custom_functions.R`

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) BIOLOGY: bin within lake first, then regional
# ------------------------------------------------------------
bio_lake_30 <- norm_abund_guilds %>%
  select(lake, age_ce, high_profile:predator) %>%
  filter(age_ce > 0) %>%
  mutate(age_ce = as.numeric(age_ce),
         age_bin = floor(age_ce / bin_size) * bin_size) %>%
  group_by(lake, age_bin) %>%
  summarise(across(high_profile:predator, ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(age_ce = age_bin)

bio_reg_30 <- bio_lake_30 %>%
  group_by(age_ce) %>%
  summarise(
    n_lakes = n_distinct(lake),
    across(high_profile:predator, ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(age_ce)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) VEGETATION: bin once
# ------------------------------------------------------------
veg_30 <- bin30(interpolated_df, time_col = "age_ce",
                cols = c("estimate", "lower_ci", "upper_ci"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) CLIMATE candidates: bin once
# ------------------------------------------------------------
nao_30          <- bin30(nao_hernandez_interpolated, time_col = "age_ce", cols = c("NAO_Median_Value"))
nhst_30         <- bin30(nhst_buntgen,               time_col = "age_ce", cols = c("Rmean"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) CTS proportions: bin once
# ------------------------------------------------------------
prop_cols <- setdiff(names(prop_comm_matrix), "age_ce")
prop_comm_30 <- bin30(prop_comm_matrix, time_col = "age_ce", cols = prop_cols)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) FINAL JOIN: all binned tables share SAME age_ce grid
# ------------------------------------------------------------
joined_df_30yr <- bio_reg_30 %>%
  left_join(nao_30, by = "age_ce") %>%
  left_join(nhst_30, by = "age_ce") %>%                 # Büntgen NHST (Rmean)
  left_join(veg_30 %>% select(age_ce, estimate), by = "age_ce") %>%  # keep only estimate here
  left_join(prop_comm_30, by = "age_ce")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Separate candidate table ONLY for preselection (no downstream dependency)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
env_candidates_30 <- bio_reg_30 %>%
  select(age_ce) %>%
  left_join(veg_30 %>% select(age_ce, estimate), by = "age_ce") %>%
  left_join(nao_30 %>% select(age_ce, NAO_Median_Value), by = "age_ce") %>%
  left_join(nhst_30 %>% select(age_ce, Rmean), by = "age_ce")

```

## Global RDA model
```{r fig.width = 8, fig.asp = 1}

# ============================================================
# GLOBAL RDA MODEL (consistent with varpart using NAO + vegetation)
# - Hellinger-transform response (as per Methods)
# - Screen predictors with ordiR2step (adjR2-based)
# - Keep a FINAL retained model with NAO + estimate for plotting + varpart
# ============================================================

# -----------------------------
# 1) Matrices
# -----------------------------
vars_to_test <- c(
  "NAO_Median_Value",
  "Rmean"#
)

comm_raw <- joined_df_30yr %>%
  dplyr::select(high_profile:predator)

env_raw <- joined_df_30yr %>%
  dplyr::select(age_ce, estimate, all_of(vars_to_test))

# keep complete cases across comm + env (same rows)
all_data <- bind_cols(comm_raw, env_raw)
complete_data <- all_data %>% filter(complete.cases(.))

comm <- complete_data %>% dplyr::select(high_profile:predator)
env  <- complete_data %>% dplyr::select(age_ce, estimate, all_of(vars_to_test))

# Hellinger transform (this is what your Methods claim)
comm_hel <- decostand(comm, method = "hellinger")

# All variables
explanatory <- env %>%
  dplyr::select(-age_ce)

# Marginal (single-predictor) tests: "significant on their own"
cat("\nMarginal (single-predictor) tests:\n")
marginal_res <- lapply(colnames(explanatory), function(v) {
  m <- capscale(comm_hel ~ ., data = explanatory[, v, drop = FALSE])
  a <- anova(m, permutations = 999)
  tibble(variable = v, F = a$F[1], p = a$`Pr(>F)`[1])
}) %>% bind_rows()

print(marginal_res)

explanatory <- env %>%
  dplyr::select(-age_ce, -Rmean, NAO_Median_Value, estimate)

final_model <- capscale(comm_hel ~ ., data = explanatory)

cat("\nFinal retained model (for biplot + matches varpart):\n")
print(anova(final_model, permutations = 999))

# -----------------------------
# 7) Biplot (only vectors for variables significant on their own OR retained)
# -----------------------------
# Criterion you asked earlier: show vectors for variables significant alone.
sig_alone <- marginal_res %>%
  filter(p < 0.05) %>%
  pull(variable)

# Always include final_vars (so climate is shown even if "alone" criterion shifts)
vars_to_plot <- unique(c(sig_alone))

bp_scores <- scores(final_model, display = "bp", scaling = 2)
bp_df <- as.data.frame(bp_scores) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  filter(Variable %in% vars_to_plot) %>%
  mutate(Label = recode(Variable,
                        estimate = "Veg. Change",
                        NAO_Median_Value = "NAO")
  )

# site scores (points)
site_scores <- scores(final_model, display = "sites", scaling = 2)
site_df <- as.data.frame(site_scores)
colnames(site_df)[1:2] <- c("CAP1", "CAP2")
site_df$age_ce <- env$age_ce

# species scores (guilds)
species_df <- as.data.frame(scores(final_model, display = "species", scaling = 2))
colnames(species_df)[1:2] <- c("CAP1", "CAP2")
species_df <- species_df %>%
  rownames_to_column("Guild") %>%
  mutate(Label = recode(Guild,
                        high_profile = "High Profile",
                        low_profile = "Low Profile",
                        motile = "Motile",
                        euplanktonic = "Euplanktonic",
                        algivore = "Algivore",
                        detritivore = "Detritivore",
                        plantivore = "Plantivore",
                        predator = "Predator"))

# axis labels
eig_vals <- final_model$CCA$eig
var_exp <- eig_vals / sum(eig_vals) * 100
axis1_lab <- paste0("CAP1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "% explained variance)")
axis2_lab <- paste0("CAP2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "% explained variance)")

global_rda <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = site_df, aes(CAP1, CAP2, color = age_ce), size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text_repel(data = species_df, aes(CAP1, CAP2, label = Label),
                  color = "red", size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", max.overlaps = Inf) +
  geom_segment(data = bp_df,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1, yend = CAP2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text_repel(data = bp_df,
                  aes(CAP1, CAP2, label = Label),
                  size = 3.5, color = "black", max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "D", name = "Age (CE)") +
  labs(x = axis1_lab, y = axis2_lab, title = NULL) +
  #coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1))
```

# Phase varpart 
## Phase varpart - Historical phases
```{r fig.width=10, fig.asp=0.5}

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Phase varpart - Historical phases
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# --- Define predictor variables ---
selected_variables <- c("estimate", "NAO_Median_Value")

# --- Define phase subsets ---
phase_list <- list(
  "Phase 1" = joined_df_30yr %>% filter(age_ce < 750),
  "Phase 2" = joined_df_30yr %>% filter(age_ce >= 750 & age_ce < 1050),
  "Phase 3" = joined_df_30yr %>% filter(age_ce >= 1050 & age_ce < 1450),
  "Phase 4" = joined_df_30yr %>% filter(age_ce >= 1450 & age_ce < 1750),
  "Phase 5" = joined_df_30yr %>% filter(age_ce >= 1750)
)

# --- Function to compute pure and shared effects ---
#   implemented in `functions/source_custom_functions.R` (calculate_pure_shared_phase)

# --- Run across all phases ---
r2_partitioned <- imap_dfr(phase_list, calculate_pure_shared_phase)

# --- Add readable and ordered phase labels ---
r2_partitioned <- r2_partitioned %>%
  mutate(
    phase_label = factor(case_when(
      phase == "Phase 1" ~ "Phase 1\n(<750 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 2" ~ "Phase 2\n(750–1050 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 3" ~ "Phase 3\n(1050–1450 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 4" ~ "Phase 4\n(1450–1750 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 5" ~ "Phase 5\n(>1750 CE)"
    ), levels = c(
      "Phase 1\n(<750 CE)",
      "Phase 2\n(750–1050 CE)",
      "Phase 3\n(1050–1450 CE)",
      "Phase 4\n(1450–1750 CE)",
      "Phase 5\n(>1750 CE)"
    ))
  )

# --- Add readable and ordered phase labels ---
r2_partitioned <- r2_partitioned %>%
  mutate(
    phase_label = factor(case_when(
      phase == "Phase 1" ~ "Phase 1\n(<750 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 2" ~ "Phase 2\n(750–1050 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 3" ~ "Phase 3\n(1050–1450 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 4" ~ "Phase 4\n(1450–1750 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 5" ~ "Phase 5\n(>1750 CE)"
    ), levels = c(
      "Phase 1\n(<750 CE)",
```

## Phase varpart - Historical phases - with significances
```{r fig.width=10, fig.asp=0.5}
# ============================================================
# PHASE varpart (YOUR PIPELINE) + SIGNIFICANCE + FADED (NS) FRACTIONS
# ============================================================

selected_variables <- c("NAO_Median_Value", "estimate")

phase_list <- list(
  "Phase 1" = joined_df_30yr %>% filter(age_ce < 750),
  "Phase 2" = joined_df_30yr %>% filter(age_ce >= 750 & age_ce < 1050),
  "Phase 3" = joined_df_30yr %>% filter(age_ce >= 1050 & age_ce < 1450),
  "Phase 4" = joined_df_30yr %>% filter(age_ce >= 1450 & age_ce < 1750),
  "Phase 5" = joined_df_30yr %>% filter(age_ce >= 1750)
)

# calculate_pure_shared_phase() in functions/source_custom_functions.R
r2_partitioned <- imap_dfr(phase_list, calculate_pure_shared_phase)

r2_partitioned <- r2_partitioned %>%
  mutate(
    phase_label = factor(case_when(
      phase == "Phase 1" ~ "Phase 1\n(<750 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 2" ~ "Phase 2\n(750–1050 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 3" ~ "Phase 3\n(1050–1450 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 4" ~ "Phase 4\n(1450–1750 CE)",
      phase == "Phase 5" ~ "Phase 5\n(>1750 CE)"
    ), levels = c(
      "Phase 1\n(<750 CE)",
      "Phase 2\n(750–1050 CE)",
      "Phase 3\n(1050–1450 CE)",
      "Phase 4\n(1450–1750 CE)",
      "Phase 5\n(>1750 CE)"
    ))
  )

component_colors <- c(
  "Pure Vegetation" = "#97D8C4",
  "Pure Climate" = "#F4B942",
  "Shared" = "#58B0E6"
)

# ============================================================
# SIGNIFICANCE + FADED (NS) FRACTIONS
# ============================================================

guild_cols <- c("high_profile","low_profile","motile","euplanktonic",
                "algivore","detritivore","plantivore","predator")

A <- "NAO_Median_Value"
B <- "estimate"

n_perm <- 9999   # use 999 for quick test
min_n  <- 5

set.seed(1)

# safe_anova_p() is implemented in `functions/source_custom_functions.R`

phase_sig <- imap_dfr(phase_list, function(dat, phase_name) {

  sub <- dat %>%
    select(age_ce, n_lakes, all_of(guild_cols), all_of(c(A, B))) %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(c(guild_cols, A, B)), ~ !is.na(.x)))

  n_bins <- nrow(sub)
  mean_n_lakes <- mean(sub$n_lakes, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (n_bins < min_n) {
    return(tibble(
      phase = phase_name,
      n_bins = n_bins,
      mean_n_lakes = mean_n_lakes,
      p_full = NA_real_,
      p_pure_A = NA_real_,
      p_pure_B = NA_real_,
      p_seq_A_then_B = NA_real_,
      p_seq_B_then_A = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  comm <- sub %>% select(all_of(guild_cols)) %>% as.matrix()
  env  <- sub %>% select(all_of(c(A, B))) %>% as.data.frame()

  # Full model
  mod_full <- vegan::rda(as.formula(paste("comm ~", paste(c(A, B), collapse = " + "))), data = env)
  p_full <- safe_anova_p(mod_full, permutations = n_perm)

  # Pure (unique) effects
  mod_pure_A <- vegan::rda(as.formula(paste("comm ~", A, "+ Condition(", B, ")")), data = env)
  mod_pure_B <- vegan::rda(as.formula(paste("comm ~", B, "+ Condition(", A, ")")), data = env)
  p_pure_A <- safe_anova_p(mod_pure_A, permutations = n_perm)
  p_pure_B <- safe_anova_p(mod_pure_B, permutations = n_perm)

  # Sequential “second term” tests (order-dependent; by="term")
  mod_A_then_B <- vegan::rda(as.formula(paste("comm ~", A, "+", B)), data = env)
  p_seq_A_then_B <- safe_anova_p(mod_A_then_B, permutations = n_perm, by = "term", which_row = 2)

  mod_B_then_A <- vegan::rda(as.formula(paste("comm ~", B, "+", A)), data = env)
  p_seq_B_then_A <- safe_anova_p(mod_B_then_A, permutations = n_perm, by = "term", which_row = 2)

  tibble(
    phase = phase_name,
    n_bins = n_bins,
    mean_n_lakes = mean_n_lakes,
    p_full = p_full,
    p_pure_A = p_pure_A,
    p_pure_B = p_pure_B,
    p_seq_A_then_B = p_seq_A_then_B,
    p_seq_B_then_A = p_seq_B_then_A
  )
})

# --- SI-ready table (effect sizes + p-values)
phase_effects_wide <- r2_partitioned %>%
  mutate(component = recode(component,
                            "Pure Climate" = paste0("Pure ", A),
                            "Pure Vegetation" = paste0("Pure ", B))) %>%
  select(phase, phase_label, component, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = value)

phase_results_table <- phase_sig %>%
  left_join(phase_effects_wide, by = "phase") %>%
  select(
    phase, n_bins, mean_n_lakes,
    `Pure NAO_Median_Value`, `Pure estimate`, Shared,
    p_full, p_pure_A, p_pure_B,
    p_seq_A_then_B, p_seq_B_then_A
  ) %>%
  arrange(phase)

phase_results_table

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FADED BARS IF NON-SIGNIFICANT (like moving window)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alpha_sig <- 1.00
alpha_ns  <- 0.25

# Shared opacity rule:
#   "always"     -> Shared always opaque
#   "full_model" -> Shared fades if full model is not significant
shared_rule <- "always"   # change to "full_model" if you prefer

phase_flags <- phase_sig %>%
  transmute(
    phase,
    sig_pure_A = p_pure_A < 0.05,
    sig_pure_B = p_pure_B < 0.05,
    sig_full   = p_full   < 0.05
  )

r2_partitioned_sig <- r2_partitioned %>%
  left_join(phase_flags, by = "phase") %>%
  mutate(
    alpha_flag = case_when(
      component == "Pure Climate"    ~ ifelse(sig_pure_A, alpha_sig, alpha_ns),
      component == "Pure Vegetation" ~ ifelse(sig_pure_B, alpha_sig, alpha_ns),
      component == "Shared" & shared_rule == "full_model" ~ ifelse(sig_full, alpha_sig, alpha_ns),
      component == "Shared" & shared_rule == "always"     ~ alpha_sig,
      TRUE ~ alpha_sig
    )
  )

historical_phase_varpart_sig <- ggplot(r2_partitioned_sig,
                            aes(x = phase_label, y = value, fill = component, alpha = alpha_flag)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    data = r2_partitioned_sig %>% filter(value > 0),
    aes(label = paste0(round(value * 100, 1), "%")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black", size = 3.2,
    inherit.aes = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +   # use alpha_flag directly; no alpha legend
  scale_fill_manual(values = component_colors, name = "Variance Component") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Adjusted R² (Variance explained)",
    caption = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, unit = "lines")
  )

historical_phase_varpart_sig
```

## Effect sizes with significances
```{r}
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Moving window varpart - Effect sizes (WORKING VERSION)
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# --- Predictor variables ---
selected_variables <- c("NAO_Median_Value", "estimate")

# --- Moving window parameters ---
window_size <- 300   # years
step_size   <- 30    # sliding step in years

# --- Define window sequence ---
min_year <- floor(min(joined_df_30yr$age_ce, na.rm = TRUE))
max_year <- ceiling(max(joined_df_30yr$age_ce, na.rm = TRUE))
window_starts <- seq(min_year, max_year - window_size, by = step_size)

# --- Run moving window analysis ---
# expects calculate_pure_shared_window(joined_df_30yr, window_start, window_size, selected_variables)
# and returns: window_start, window_end, component, value
r2_windowed <- map_dfr(
  window_starts,
  ~calculate_pure_shared_window(joined_df_30yr, .x, window_size, selected_variables)
) %>%
  mutate(midpoint = (window_start + window_end) / 2)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Effect size difference (Veg - Climate) + join significance
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# window_sig must exist and contain: window_start, window_end, midpoint, p_pure_A, p_pure_B
# IMPORTANT: set which p-value corresponds to which fraction:
# Here I assume:
#   p_pure_A = Pure Climate
#   p_pure_B = Pure Vegetation
# If your function returns the opposite, just swap them below.

stopifnot(exists("window_sig"))

effect_diff <- r2_windowed %>%
  filter(component %in% c("Pure Vegetation", "Pure Climate")) %>%
  select(window_start, window_end, midpoint, component, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = value) %>%
  left_join(
    window_sig %>% select(window_start, window_end, midpoint, p_pure_A, p_pure_B),
    by = c("window_start", "window_end", "midpoint")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effect_diff = `Pure Vegetation` - `Pure Climate`,
    effect_group = case_when(
      effect_diff > 0 & midpoint < 750  ~ "VegChange > Climate (pre-750)",
      effect_diff > 0 & midpoint >= 750 ~ "VegChange > Climate (post-750)",
      effect_diff < 0                   ~ "Climate > VegChange",
      TRUE                              ~ NA_character_
    ),
    sig_clim = !is.na(p_pure_A) & p_pure_A < 0.05,
    sig_veg  = !is.na(p_pure_B) & p_pure_B < 0.05,
    direction = case_when(
      effect_diff > 0 ~ "veg",
      effect_diff < 0 ~ "clim",
      TRUE            ~ NA_character_
    ),
    alpha_flag = case_when(
      direction == "veg"  & sig_veg  ~ 1.0,
      direction == "veg"  & !sig_veg ~ 0.25,
      direction == "clim" & sig_clim ~ 1.0,
      direction == "clim" & !sig_clim~ 0.25,
      TRUE ~ 0.25
    )
  )

effect_diff <- effect_diff %>%
  filter(!is.na(effect_group))

# --- Colors ---
effect_colors_split <- c(
  "VegChange > Climate (pre-750)"  = "#054A29",
  "VegChange > Climate (post-750)" = "#6DC6B6",
  "Climate > VegChange"            = "#F4B942"
)

# If you don't have phase_lines defined, comment this out or define it:
# phase_lines <- c(1000, 1450, 1750)   # example
if (!exists("phase_lines")) phase_lines <- numeric(0)


# ---- Define common x-scale ----
x_min <- floor(min(joined_df_30yr$age_ce, na.rm = TRUE) / 100) * 100
x_max <- ceiling(max(joined_df_30yr$age_ce, na.rm = TRUE) / 100) * 100

common_breaks  <- seq(x_min, x_max, by = 200)   # major grid
common_minor   <- seq(x_min, x_max, by = 100)   # minor grid

# --- Plot ---
effect_diff_plot_sig <- ggplot(
  effect_diff,
  aes(x = midpoint, y = effect_diff, fill = effect_group, alpha = alpha_flag)
) +
  geom_col(width = step_size) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = effect_colors_split,
  name = "Dominant Driver",
  drop = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = phase_lines, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray30") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_min, x_max),
    breaks = common_breaks,
    minor_breaks = common_minor,
    expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year (CE)",
    y = "Effect size (Vegetation − Climate)",
    title = "(c) Relative dominance of VegChange vs. climate",
    caption = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, unit = "lines")
  )

effect_diff_plot_sig
```

# Sensitivty analyses
## Sensitivty analyses - PHASE-BOUNDARY ROBUSTNESS (GRID TEST)
```{r}
# ============================================================
# SENSITIVITY: PHASE-BOUNDARY ROBUSTNESS (GRID TEST)
# ============================================================

guild_cols <- c("high_profile","low_profile","motile","euplanktonic",
                "algivore","detritivore","plantivore","predator")

env_predictors <- c("NAO_Median_Value", "estimate")
A <- env_predictors[1]  # NAO
B <- env_predictors[2]  # Veg

# -------------------------
# calc_phase_varpart(), make_phase_breaks(), run_one_boundary_set()
# are in `functions/source_custom_functions.R`
# -------------------------

# ---- baseline boundaries ----
base_bounds <- c(750, 1050, 1450, 1750)

# ---- settings: shift boundaries by k bins (bin=30 yrs) ----
bin_size <- 30
max_shift_bins <- 2  # +/- 2 bins => +/- 60 years
shift_vals <- seq(-max_shift_bins, max_shift_bins) * bin_size

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Grid of boundary perturbations
# - enforce ordering: b1 < b2 < b3 < b4
# - enforce minimum bins per phase (min_n)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
min_n <- 5  # same as your phase varpart threshold

boundary_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
  d1 = shift_vals,
  d2 = shift_vals,
  d3 = shift_vals,
  d4 = shift_vals
) %>%
  mutate(
    b1 = base_bounds[1] + d1,
    b2 = base_bounds[2] + d2,
    b3 = base_bounds[3] + d3,
    b4 = base_bounds[4] + d4
  ) %>%
  filter(b1 < b2, b2 < b3, b3 < b4) %>%
  mutate(grid_id = row_number())

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Baseline run (for comparison)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
phase_breaks_base <- make_phase_breaks(base_bounds[1], base_bounds[2], base_bounds[3], base_bounds[4])

r2_base_phase <- calc_phase_varpart(
  joined_df_30yr,
  guild_cols = guild_cols,
  env_predictors = env_predictors,
  phase_breaks = phase_breaks_base,
  min_n = min_n
)

base_wide <- r2_base_phase %>%
  select(phase, component, value, n_bins) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = value) %>%
  rename(base_n_bins = n_bins)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run varpart for each perturbed boundary set
# ------------------------------------------------------------
r2_phase_boundary_sens_long <- pmap_dfr(
  boundary_grid %>% select(b1, b2, b3, b4, grid_id),
  run_one_boundary_set
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compare each run to baseline, phase-by-phase
# ------------------------------------------------------------
r2_phase_boundary_sens <- r2_phase_boundary_sens_long %>%
  left_join(
    r2_base_phase %>%
      select(phase, component, base_value = value, base_n_bins = n_bins),
    by = c("phase","component")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_value = value - base_value,
    abs_delta   = abs(delta_value)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Summaries you can report in SI:
# - max absolute deviation from baseline by component x phase
# - how often sign/dominance flips (veg vs climate) by phase
# ------------------------------------------------------------
A <- env_predictors[1]  # NAO
B <- env_predictors[2]  # estimate

sens_summary_phase_component <- r2_phase_boundary_sens %>%
  group_by(phase, component) %>%
  summarise(
    n_runs = n(),
    max_abs_delta = max(abs_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abs_delta = median(abs_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(phase, component)

# dominance flips: whether Pure B >= Pure A within a phase
sens_dom <- r2_phase_boundary_sens_long %>%
  filter(component %in% c(paste0("Pure ", A), paste0("Pure ", B))) %>%
  select(grid_id, phase, component, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(
    dom_B = .data[[paste0("Pure ", B)]] >= .data[[paste0("Pure ", A)]]
  ) %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_runs_B_dominant = mean(dom_B, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sens_summary_phase_component
sens_dom
```
