## Sensitivty analyses - Leave-one-out per phases
```{r}
# -------------------------
# Settings
# -------------------------
guild_cols <- c("high_profile","low_profile","motile","euplanktonic",
                "algivore","detritivore","plantivore","predator")

env_predictors <- c("NAO_Median_Value", "estimate")
A <- env_predictors[1]  # NAO
B <- env_predictors[2]  # Veg

# Phase definitions (same as your plot)
phase_breaks <- list(
  "Phase 1" = c(-Inf, 750),
  "Phase 2" = c(750, 1050),
  "Phase 3" = c(1050, 1450),
  "Phase 4" = c(1450, 1750),
  "Phase 5" = c(1750, Inf)
)

# -------------------------
# Helper: rebuild joined table from a bio_reg_30 (for LOO)
# (consistent with your Step 5+6: align then scale)
# -------------------------
# build_joined_from_bio_reg() is implemented in `functions/source_custom_functions.R`

# -------------------------
# 1) BASELINE (all lakes) — phase varpart
# -------------------------
r2_base_phase <- calc_phase_varpart(
  joined_df_30yr,
  guild_cols = guild_cols,
  env_predictors = env_predictors,
  phase_breaks = phase_breaks,
  min_n = 5
)

# wide baseline for deltas
base_wide <- r2_base_phase %>%
  select(phase, component, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = value)

# overall baseline summaries (across phases)
base_summary <- r2_base_phase %>%
  filter(component %in% c(paste0("Pure ", A), paste0("Pure ", B), "Shared")) %>%
  group_by(component) %>%
  summarise(
    base_mean   = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    base_median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = component,
              values_from = c(base_mean, base_median))

# -------------------------
# 2) LOO — recompute bio_reg_30 then joined then phase varpart
# -------------------------
lakes <- sort(unique(bio_lake_30$lake))

r2_loo_phase <- map_dfr(lakes, function(lk) {

  bio_reg_loo <- bio_lake_30 %>%
    filter(lake != lk) %>%
    group_by(age_ce) %>%
    summarise(
      n_lakes = n_distinct(lake),
      across(all_of(guild_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  joined_loo <- build_joined_from_bio_reg(
    bio_reg_loo,
    nao_30 = nao_30, nhst_30 = nhst_30, veg_30 = veg_30, prop_comm_30 = prop_comm_30,
    env_cols = c("NAO_Median_Value","Rmean","estimate")
  )

  out <- calc_phase_varpart(
    joined_loo,
    guild_cols = guild_cols,
    env_predictors = env_predictors,
    phase_breaks = phase_breaks,
    min_n = 5
  )

  out %>% mutate(leave_out = lk)
})

# -------------------------
# Summary table
# -------------------------
loo_phase_wide <- r2_loo_phase %>%
  select(leave_out, phase, component, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = value)

# dominance per phase: B (veg) >= A (NAO)
loo_phase_dom <- loo_phase_wide %>%
  mutate(
    dominant = ifelse(.data[[paste0("Pure ", B)]] >= .data[[paste0("Pure ", A)]], B, A)
  ) %>%
  group_by(leave_out) %>%
  summarise(
    n_phases = n(),
    prop_phases_B_dominant = mean(dominant == B, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_phases_A_dominant = mean(dominant == A, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# effect sizes averaged across phases
loo_phase_effects <- loo_phase_wide %>%
  group_by(leave_out) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pure_A    = mean(.data[[paste0("Pure ", A)]], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pure_B    = mean(.data[[paste0("Pure ", B)]], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_shared    = mean(.data[["Shared"]], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pure_A  = median(.data[[paste0("Pure ", A)]], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pure_B  = median(.data[[paste0("Pure ", B)]], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_shared  = median(.data[["Shared"]], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff_BA   = mean(.data[[paste0("Pure ", B)]] - .data[[paste0("Pure ", A)]], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# deltas vs baseline (across phases)
base_means <- r2_base_phase %>%
  filter(component %in% c(paste0("Pure ", A), paste0("Pure ", B), "Shared")) %>%
  group_by(component) %>%
  summarise(base_mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
  deframe()

loo_phase_vs_base <- loo_phase_effects %>%
  mutate(
    delta_mean_pure_A = mean_pure_A - base_means[[paste0("Pure ", A)]],
    delta_mean_pure_B = mean_pure_B - base_means[[paste0("Pure ", B)]],
    delta_mean_shared = mean_shared - base_means[["Shared"]]
  )

# final appendix table
loo_phase_summary <- loo_phase_vs_base %>%
  left_join(loo_phase_dom, by = "leave_out") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(delta_mean_pure_B)))  # or any ordering you like

loo_phase_summary

# OPTIONAL: per-phase values in wide form for appendix too
# (one row per leave-out, columns per phase x component)
loo_phase_perphase <- r2_loo_phase %>%
  mutate(phase_component = paste(phase, component, sep = " — ")) %>%
  select(leave_out, phase_component, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = phase_component, values_from = value)

loo_phase_perphase
```

## Sensitivity analyses - Leave one out - moving window
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Inputs that already exist from your pipeline above:
#   bio_lake_30      (lake-level binned biology)
#   joined_df_30yr   (regional biology + aligned env + scaled)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

guild_cols <- c("high_profile","low_profile","motile","euplanktonic",
                "algivore","detritivore","plantivore","predator")

# predictors (already scaled in joined_df_30yr)
env_predictors <- c("NAO_Median_Value", "estimate")  # add "Rmean" if you want later

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Window varpart working DIRECTLY on joined_df_30yr
# calc_window_varpart_joined() in functions/source_custom_functions.R
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# run
guild_cols <- c("high_profile","low_profile","motile","euplanktonic",
                "algivore","detritivore","plantivore","predator")
env_predictors <- c("NAO_Median_Value", "estimate")

# Run
r2_base <- calc_window_varpart_joined(
  joined_df_30yr,
  window_size = 300, step_size = 30, min_bins = 5,
  guild_cols = c("high_profile","low_profile","motile","euplanktonic",
                "algivore","detritivore","plantivore","predator"),
  env_predictors = c("NAO_Median_Value", "estimate")
)

# Base result using the already-aligned joined_df_30yr
r2_base <- calc_window_varpart_joined(joined_df_30yr,
                                      window_size = 300, step_size = 30, min_bins = 5)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Leave-one-out: recompute bio_reg_30 (regional) from bio_lake_30,
# then rebuild joined table on SAME age_ce grid, then scale, then varpart
# build_joined_from_bio_reg() in functions/source_custom_functions.R
# ------------------------------------------------------------

lakes <- sort(unique(bio_lake_30$lake))

r2_loo <- map_dfr(lakes, function(lk) {

  bio_reg_loo <- bio_lake_30 %>%
    filter(lake != lk) %>%
    group_by(age_ce) %>%
    summarise(
      n_lakes = n_distinct(lake),
      across(all_of(guild_cols), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  joined_loo <- build_joined_from_bio_reg(
    bio_reg_loo,
    nao_30 = nao_30, nhst_30 = nhst_30, veg_30 = veg_30, prop_comm_30 = prop_comm_30
  )

  out <- calc_window_varpart_joined(joined_loo,
                                    window_size = 300, step_size = 30, min_bins = 5)

  out %>% mutate(leave_out = lk)
})

dominance_loo <- r2_loo %>%
  select(leave_out, midpoint, component, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(dominant = ifelse(.data[[paste0("Pure ", env_predictors[2])]] >=
                             .data[[paste0("Pure ", env_predictors[1])]],
                           "SecondPredictor", "FirstPredictor")) %>%
  group_by(leave_out) %>%
  summarise(prop_windows_second_pred_dominant = mean(dominant == "SecondPredictor", na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

A <- env_predictors[1]  # "NAO_Median_Value"
B <- env_predictors[2]  # "estimate"

# ---- 1) Summarise effect sizes per lake (mean/median across windows) ----
loo_effects <- r2_loo %>%
  filter(component %in% c(paste0("Pure ", A), paste0("Pure ", B))) %>%
  select(leave_out, midpoint, component, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = value) %>%
  group_by(leave_out) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pure_A    = mean(.data[[paste0("Pure ", A)]], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pure_B    = mean(.data[[paste0("Pure ", B)]], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pure_A  = median(.data[[paste0("Pure ", A)]], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pure_B  = median(.data[[paste0("Pure ", B)]], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff_BA   = mean(.data[[paste0("Pure ", B)]] - .data[[paste0("Pure ", A)]], na.rm = TRUE),
    n_windows      = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- 2) Your existing dominance metric (keep it) ----
dominance_loo <- r2_loo %>%
  select(leave_out, midpoint, component, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(
    dominant = ifelse(
      .data[[paste0("Pure ", B)]] >= .data[[paste0("Pure ", A)]],
      B, A
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(leave_out) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_windows_B_dominant = mean(dominant == B, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_windows_A_dominant = mean(dominant == A, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- 3) Combine into one tidy table ----
loo_summary <- loo_effects %>%
  left_join(dominance_loo, by = "leave_out")

loo_summary

# baseline (all lakes)
base_effects <- r2_base %>%
  filter(component %in% c(paste0("Pure ", A), paste0("Pure ", B))) %>%
  select(midpoint, component, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = component, values_from = value) %>%
  summarise(
    base_mean_pure_A = mean(.data[[paste0("Pure ", A)]], na.rm = TRUE),
    base_mean_pure_B = mean(.data[[paste0("Pure ", B)]], na.rm = TRUE)
  )

loo_summary_vs_base <- loo_summary %>%
  mutate(
    delta_mean_pure_A = mean_pure_A - base_effects$base_mean_pure_A,
    delta_mean_pure_B = mean_pure_B - base_effects$base_mean_pure_B
  )

loo_summary_vs_base
```

```{r fig.asp=0.75, fig.width=12}
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Combine smoothed GAM outputs and DCA scores across groups
# ----------------------------------------------------------

smooth_all_in_one <- 
  bind_rows(
    cbind(type = rep("diatoms", nrow(smooth_diatoms)), smooth_diatoms),
    cbind(type = rep("chiro", nrow(smooth_diatoms)), smooth_chiro)
  )

df_all_in_one <- 
  bind_rows(
    cbind(type = rep("diatoms", nrow(b_ls_dca_diatoms)), b_ls_dca_diatoms),
    cbind(type = rep("chiro", nrow(b_ls_dca_chiro)), b_ls_dca_chiro)
  )

# ==========================================================
# Fig 1b (FINAL): NAO panel on top + main panel (DCA + vegetation)
# ==========================================================

# -----------------------------
# 1) Species smooth (diatoms + chiro)
# -----------------------------
smooth_main <- smooth_all_in_one %>%
  filter(.smooth == "s(age_ce)") %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("diatoms", "chiro")))

smooth_lines <- smooth_main %>%
  mutate(group_label = if_else(type == "diatoms", "Producers", "Consumers"))

# -----------------------------
# 2) Vegetation smooth (from sm_to)
# -----------------------------
veg_bg <- sm_to %>%
  filter(.smooth == "s(age_ce)") %>%
  transmute(
    age_ce  = age_ce,
    veg_est = .estimate,
    veg_lo  = .lower_ci,
    veg_hi  = .upper_ci
  ) %>%
  arrange(age_ce)

# -----------------------------
# 3) Map vegetation onto DCA axis (fixed veg range)
# -----------------------------
veg_limits <- c(-1.5, 1.5)
dca_rng <- range(c(smooth_main$.lower_ci, smooth_main$.upper_ci), na.rm = TRUE)

# veg_to_dca() and dca_to_veg() are implemented in `functions/source_custom_functions.R`

# -----------------------------
# 4) NAO series (median per age_ce, centered anomaly)
# -----------------------------
nao_series <- nao_hernandez %>%
  group_by(age_ce) %>%
  summarise(nao = median(NAO_Median_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(age_ce) %>%
  filter(is.finite(nao)) %>%
  mutate(
    nao_anom = nao - median(nao, na.rm = TRUE),
    y0 = 0,
    y_pos = pmax(nao_anom, 0),
    y_neg = pmin(nao_anom, 0)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 5) Aesthetics
# -----------------------------
alpha_ci_species <- 0.10
alpha_ci_veg     <- 0.10
alpha_nao        <- 0.35

lw_species <- 3.6
lw_veg     <- 2.8

# Producers yellow, Consumers purple, Vegetation mid-viridis green
cols_line <- c(
  "Consumers"  = viridisLite::viridis(9)[1],
  "Vegetation" = viridisLite::viridis(9)[5],
  "Producers"  = viridisLite::viridis(9)[9]
)
cols_fill_species <- c(
  "Producers" = cols_line["Producers"],
  "Consumers" = cols_line["Consumers"]
)

# -----------------------------
# 6) TOP panel: NAO with normal axis (no x-axis shown)
# -----------------------------
p_nao <- ggplot(nao_series, aes(x = age_ce)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y0, ymax = y_pos), fill = "red",  alpha = alpha_nao) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y_neg, ymax = y0), fill = "blue", alpha = alpha_nao) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2020), n.breaks = 5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "NAO (median anomaly)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x   = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(5.5, 5.5, 0, 5.5)  # bottom margin = 0
  )

# -----------------------------
# 7) BOTTOM panel: DCA smooths + vegetation (sec.axis)
# -----------------------------
p_main <- ggplot() +
  # Vegetation (CI + line)
  geom_ribbon(
    data = veg_bg,
    aes(x = age_ce, ymin = veg_to_dca(veg_lo), ymax = veg_to_dca(veg_hi)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = cols_line["Vegetation"],
    alpha = alpha_ci_veg,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = veg_bg,
    aes(x = age_ce, y = veg_to_dca(veg_est), colour = "Vegetation"),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = lw_veg
  ) +
  # Species CI + lines
  geom_ribbon(
    data = smooth_lines,
    aes(x = age_ce, ymin = .lower_ci, ymax = .upper_ci, fill = group_label),
    alpha = alpha_ci_species,
    linewidth = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = smooth_lines,
    aes(x = age_ce, y = .estimate, colour = group_label),
    linewidth = lw_species
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = cols_line,
    breaks = c("Producers", "Consumers", "Vegetation")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_fill_species, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "DCA1 (regional smooth)",
    limits = c(-1.75, 1),  # your final y-lims
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ dca_to_veg(.), name = "Regional vegetation change (HGAM smooth)")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2020), n.breaks = 5) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)  # top margin = 0
  )

# -----------------------------
# 8) Stack with ZERO gap
# -----------------------------
final_fig <- p_nao / p_main +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.55, 2)) &
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"))

final_fig

# -----------------------------
# Export
# -----------------------------
ggsave(
  "figures/FIGURE_2a_all_regional_smooths_with_NAO_panel.pdf",
  plot = final_fig,
  dpi = 300, width = 300, height = 150, units = "mm"
)
```

```{r fig.asp=2, fig.width=12}
# remove lakes you don't want
ls_plot_df_dca_multi_all_named <- ls_plot_df_dca_multi_all_named[!names(ls_plot_df_dca_multi_all_named) %in% c("Furnas","Fogo")]

scatterplots <- map(ls_plot_df_dca_multi_all_named, ~ ggplotGrob(.x))

# -----------------------------
# 3) Lake points (sf)
# -----------------------------
lake_centers <- data.frame(
  lake = lake_metadata$lake,
  lat  = lake_metadata$lat,
  lon  = lake_metadata$long
)

island_points <- st_as_sf(lake_centers, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# -----------------------------
# 4) Bounding box for Azores map (adjust if needed)
# -----------------------------
xmin <- -32.0 - 0.75 * abs(-32.0 + 24.5)
xmax <- -24.5 + 0.75 * abs(-32.0 + 24.5)
ymin <-  36.5 - 0.5  * abs(40.0 - 36.5)
ymax <-  40.0 + 0.5  * abs(40.0 - 36.5)

azores_bbox <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), crs = 4326))

# -----------------------------
# 5) Coastline + crop
# -----------------------------
coastline_shapefile <- st_read("data/ne_10m_coastline/ne_10m_coastline.shp", quiet = TRUE)
azores_coastline <- st_crop(coastline_shapefile, azores_bbox)

# -----------------------------
# 6) Where to place the embedded mini-plots
#     (must match the order of scatterplots)
# -----------------------------
scatterplot_positions <- list(
  c(xmax - 1.5, ymax - 1),                # Azul
  c(xmin + 1.5, ymax - 1),                # Caldeirão
  c(xmin + 1.5, ymin + 1),                # Caveiro
  c(xmax - 1.5, (ymax + ymin) / 2),       # Empadadas Norte
  c(xmin + 1.5, (ymax + ymin) / 2),       # Funda
  c(xmin + (xmax - xmin) / 2, ymin + 1),  # Ginjal
  c(((xmin + 1.5)+(xmin + (xmax - xmin) / 2))/2, ymin + 1),     # Peixinho
  c(((xmin + (xmax - xmin) / 2)+(xmax - 1.5))/2, ymin + 1),     # Prata
  c(xmax - 1.5, ymin + 1)                 # Santiago
)

# segments from inset positions to lake points
segment_data <- data.frame(
  x    = sapply(scatterplot_positions, `[[`, 1),
  y    = sapply(scatterplot_positions, `[[`, 2),
  xend = st_coordinates(island_points$geometry)[, 1],
  yend = st_coordinates(island_points$geometry)[, 2]
)

# -----------------------------
# 7) Build the final plot (single panel)
# -----------------------------
final_fig <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = azores_coastline, fill = "lightblue", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = island_points, shape = 21, size = 3.2, stroke = 0.3,
          fill = "grey70", colour = "white") +
  geom_segment(
    data = segment_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(xmin, xmax), ylim = c(ymin, ymax), datum = sf::st_crs(4326), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1)  # IMPORTANT: no outer whitespace
  ) +
  ggtitle("(b) Detailed map of the Azores Archipelago") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = -2)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(xmin, xmax + 1.0), ylim = c(ymin, ymax), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 20, 0, 20))   # add right margin (pt)

final_fig <- final_fig +
  labs(x = "Year (CE)") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 6)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
    #axis.line.x  = element_line(linewidth = 0.3)
  )

# Optional north arrow (remove if not needed)
final_fig <- final_fig +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "bl", which_north = "true",
    pad_x = unit(0.25, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.25, "in"),
    style = north_arrow_minimal()
  )

# -----------------------------
# 8) Overlay the inset plots
# -----------------------------
scatterplot_scale_x <- 2 * 0.85
scatterplot_scale_y <- 1.5 * 0.75

for (i in seq_along(scatterplots)) {
  final_fig <- final_fig +
    annotation_custom(
      scatterplots[[i]],
      xmin = scatterplot_positions[[i]][1] - scatterplot_scale_x,
      xmax = scatterplot_positions[[i]][1] + scatterplot_scale_x,
      ymin = scatterplot_positions[[i]][2] - scatterplot_scale_y,
      ymax = scatterplot_positions[[i]][2] + scatterplot_scale_y
    )
}

final_fig

# -----------------------------
# 9) Export (force no clipping and use full width)
# -----------------------------
ggsave(
  "figures/FIGURE_2b_azores_inset_DCA.pdf",
  plot = final_fig,
  dpi = 300, width = 180, height = 90, units = "mm",
  limitsize = FALSE
)
```

```{r fig.asp=2, fig.width=12}
# --------------------------------------------
```

## FIGURE 5 - Historical and Moving Window Variance Partitioning
```{r fig.width = 10, fig.asp = 1}
# Single-column layout: legends below each panel, consistent font scaling.
# --------------------------------------------
# Global figure controls (edit once)
# --------------------------------------------
base_size       <- 10   # overall text size (single-column friendly)
title_size      <- 11
axis_title_size <- 10
axis_text_size  <- 9
legend_title_sz <- 9
legend_text_sz  <- 8

# Single-column width (PNAS is typically ~3.3–3.5 in for 1-col figures)
# Use 3.5 if you want strict 1-col; 4.5 is safer for readability.
fig_width  <- 4.5
fig_height <- 10

# STEP 1: Define historical transition years
phase_lines <- c(750, 1050, 1450, 1750)

# --------------------------------------------
# A shared theme applied to ALL three panels
# --------------------------------------------
panel_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    plot.title        = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.title      = element_text(size = legend_title_sz),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = legend_text_sz),
    legend.key.height = unit(3.0, "mm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(6.0, "mm"),
    plot.margin       = ggplot2::margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
  )

# --------------------------------------------
# Panel-specific legend helper
# (3 rows for a and b; and also for c)
# --------------------------------------------
legend_3rows <- guides(
  fill  = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),
  color = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),
  alpha = "none"
)

# --------------------------------------------
# Panel A
# --------------------------------------------
p_a <- historical_phase_varpart_sig +
  ggtitle("(a) Historical phases") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3", "Phase 4", "Phase 5")) +
  panel_theme +
  legend_3rows

# --------------------------------------------
# Panel B
# --------------------------------------------
p_b <- moving_window_varpart_sig +
  ggtitle("(b) Moving window") +
  panel_theme +
  legend_3rows

# --------------------------------------------
# Panel C
# --------------------------------------------
p_c <- effect_diff_plot_sig +
  ggtitle("(c) Climate vs VegChange") +
  panel_theme +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),
    alpha = "none"
  )

# If any panel still shows an "NA" legend entry, uncomment:
# p_c <- p_c + scale_fill_discrete(na.translate = FALSE)

# --------------------------------------------
# Combine (single column) — keep legends under each panel
# --------------------------------------------
combined_varplot <- p_a / p_b / p_c +
  plot_layout(guides = "keep", heights = c(1, 1.2, 1))

print(combined_varplot)

# --------------------------------------------
# Save output (single-column)
# --------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  plot     = combined_varplot,
  filename = "figures/FIGURE_5_varparts_singlecol.png",
  dpi      = 600,
  width    = fig_width,
  height   = fig_height,
  units    = "in",
  bg       = "white"
)

ggsave(
  plot     = combined_varplot,
  filename = "figures/FIGURE_5_varparts_singlecol.pdf",
  dpi      = 600,
  width    = fig_width,
  height   = fig_height,
  units    = "in",
  bg       = "white"
)
```

```{r fig.width=12, fig.asp=0.5}
  geom_point(aes(color = sign), size = 1) +  # Positive (red) / negative (blue) deviations
  scale_color_manual(values = c("positive" = "red", "negative" = "blue")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +  # zero reference

  # Add 50-year smoothed trend line
  geom_line(data = nhst_30, aes(x = age_ce, y = Rmean),
            color = "steelblue", linewidth = 2) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "NH Summer Temperature reconstruction (Tree Rings)",
    x = "Year CE",
    y = "Temperature Anomaly",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# --------------------------------------
# Plot 2: North Atlantic Oscillation (NAO) median values
# --------------------------------------
nao_plot <- ggplot(nao_df, aes(x = age_ce, y = NAO_Median_Value)) +
  geom_line(size = 1, color = "grey") +  # Raw NAO data
  geom_point(aes(color = sign), size = 1) +  # Red/blue anomalies
  scale_color_manual(values = c("positive" = "red", "negative" = "blue")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +

  # Add 50-year smoothed trend line
 #geom_line(data = nao_30, aes(x = age_ce, y = NAO_Median_Value),
 #          color = "steelblue", linewidth = 2) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "NAO Anomaly",
    x = "Year CE",
    y = "NAO Median",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# --------------------------------------
# Custom Theme for Plot Tag Styling
# --------------------------------------
tag_theme <- theme(
  plot.tag.position = c(0, 1),
  plot.tag = element_text(
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = -2,
    face = "bold",
    size = 11,
    margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 10, unit = "pt")  # Left indent for tag
  ),
  plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(20, 10, 10, 10, unit = "pt")  # Standard margins
)

# --------------------------------------
# Assemble Tagged and Themed Panels
# --------------------------------------
nhst_buntgen_panel <- nhst_buntgen_plot + 
  labs(tag = "(a) NH Summer Temperature Anomaly reconstruction (Tree Rings)", title = NULL) + 
  tag_theme +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())  # remove x-axis label

nao_panel <- nao_plot + 
  labs(tag = "(b) NAO Index", title = NULL) + 
  tag_theme +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())  # remove x-axis label

# --------------------------------------
# Combine Panels Vertically with patchwork
# --------------------------------------
final_plot_2 <- 
  (nhst_buntgen_panel + nao_panel) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 1, nrow = 3,
                         heights = c(20, 20, 20)) +  # Equal height for each plot
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = NULL,
    theme = theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 10, 30, 10, unit = "pt"),  # extra bottom space
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12)
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------
# Export to PNG
# --------------------------------------

# Set PNG output for saving the tree plot
png("supplementary/supplementary_figure_S2.png", width = 8, height = 8, units = "in", res = 600)

# Plot
final_plot_2

# Close the graphics device
dev.off()
```

## SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE S3 - Pollen GAM
```{r fig.width = 8, fig.asp = 1.5}

# --------------------------------------
# Plot 1: Group-Specific Pollen Trends (Tree vs Herb)
# --------------------------------------
group_trend_plot <- ggplot(combined_df_pollen, aes(x = age_ce, y = percent, color = group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +  # Raw points with transparency
  geom_smooth(
    method = "gam",
    formula = y ~ s(x, k = 30),  # GAM smoothing with 30 knots
    se = TRUE,
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Tree" = "#3a6520", "Herb" = "#dbbc3f"),  # Custom color for each pollen group
    labels = c("Tree" = "Tree", "Herb" = "Herb"),
    name = "Pollen Group"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Vegetation change",
    x = "Age (CE)",
    y = "% Abundance"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 2010)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# --------------------------------------
# Plot 2: Regional Pollen Turnover (GI model smooth)
# --------------------------------------
regional_smooth_plot <- interpolated_df %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci, x = age_ce),
              alpha = 0.2) +  # Confidence interval
  geom_line(aes(x = age_ce, y = estimate), lwd = 1) +  # Smooth estimate line
  labs(y = "DCA1", title = "s(age_ce) GI model") +
  scale_color_manual("Time-Interval", values = lakes_col) +  # Optional (no visible use)
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  lims(y = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(title = NULL) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# --------------------------------------
# Panel A: Regional pollen turnover with label
# --------------------------------------
regional_panel_A <- regional_smooth_plot +
  labs(title = "(a) Regional Pollen Community Turnover") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# --------------------------------------
# Panel B: Tree vs Herb pollen dynamics with label
# --------------------------------------
group_panel_B <- group_trend_plot +
  labs(title = "(b) Tree and Herb pollen dynamics") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# --------------------------------------
# Combine Panels into Final Supplementary Figure
# --------------------------------------
final_combined_plot_pollen <- 
  regional_panel_A + 
  group_panel_B +
  patchwork::plot_layout(nrow = 2, heights = c(1, 1)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------
# Export to PNG
# --------------------------------------
png("supplementary/supplementary_figure_S3_vegetation_change.png", 
    width = 7.29, height = 4.51, units = "in", res = 600)

# Render the plot to file
final_combined_plot_pollen

# Close the graphics device
dev.off()

```

### SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE S5 - Community Trophic Structures over time
```{r fig.asp = 1.5, fig.width = 12}
# -----------------------------------------------
# Convert PNG tree plot into a ggplot-compatible object
# -----------------------------------------------
tree_grob_paleo <- grid::rasterGrob(png::readPNG("outputs/decision_tree_paleo.png"))

# Create a ggplot with the decision tree image embedded as a background
tree_image_panel <- ggplot() +
  annotation_custom(tree_grob_paleo, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf) +
  theme_void() +
  ggtitle("Functional group classification by ecosystem type")  # Title for Panel D

# -----------------------------------------------
# Clean up lake-scale density plot (remove redundant legend)
# -----------------------------------------------
lake_scale_density_plot <- plot_density_fclusts_time_lines_1B + 
  guides(fill = "none")  # Remove fill legend (i.e., for functional groups)

# -----------------------------------------------
# Define layout structure for patchwork combination
# -----------------------------------------------
patchwork_layout_design <- "
AAAA
DDDD
DDDD
DDDD
"

# -----------------------------------------------
# Assemble Supplementary Figure 4
# -----------------------------------------------

# Panel A: Regional scale
panel_regional_stacked <- plot_stacked_fclusts_time_lines +
  ggtitle(" (a) Community Trophic Structures over time [regional scale]") +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(1, 2, 1, 2), "pt"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

# Panel B: Lake scale
panel_lake_density <- lake_scale_density_plot +
  ggtitle(" (b) Community Trophic Structures over time [lake scale]") +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(1, 2, 1, 2), "pt"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )
# Combine panels using patchwork with layout control
supplementary_figure_5 <- 
  (panel_regional_stacked + panel_lake_density) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(
    design = patchwork_layout_design,
    heights = c(40, 80),
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
  #patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') &
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt"),  # Minimize outer spacing
    legend.position = 'bottom'               # Merge legends at the bottom
  )

# -----------------------------------------------
# Display the combined supplementary figure
# -----------------------------------------------
print(supplementary_figure_5)

# -----------------------------------------------
# Save to file
# -----------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  plot = supplementary_figure_5,
  filename = "supplementary/supplementary_figure_S5.png",
  dpi = 600,
  width = 12,
  height = 16
)
```
